tasks_completed.description: Fix session/[id].tsx param reading to use useLocalSearchParams
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced useRoute() from @react-navigation/native with useLocalSearchParams from expo-router. useRoute() does not react to param changes when the screen is reused via dangerouslySingular, so direct URL navigation and sidebar session switching showed the wrong session. Now the component correctly reads the id param from Expo Router's param system on every navigation.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: useRoute() predates the Expo Router migration (commits 7f178466/c6c99ee4). useLocalSearchParams is the Expo Router API and reacts correctly to dangerouslySingular param updates.

tasks_completed.description: Fix [messageId].tsx back navigation to use navigateToSession() instead of router.back()
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced router.back() with navigateToSession(router, sessionId!) in the 'message not found' effect. Also added navigateToSession import. Extracted ToolScreenHeader and LoadingView into separate components to satisfy quality gate (MAX_FUNC_LINES=30). Removed duplicate message null guard in the render path (consolidated into single !session || !messagesLoaded || !message check).
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: router.back() on web pops the browser history stack, which may not contain the parent session URL when the user arrived via sidebar navigation (router.navigate with dangerouslySingular). navigateToSession() uses router.navigate() which always goes to the correct /session/:id route regardless of history state.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 (fix: fix monorepo, original useNavigateToSession), c6c99ee4 (Improve session push notifications and routing, added dangerouslySingular)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: useRoute() was in place before Expo Router migration; dangerouslySingular was added later to prevent multiple session screens in the stack, but useRoute() does not re-render when dangerouslySingular reuses the same screen with new params. router.back() was used before dangerouslySingular was adopted and does not account for navigate (not push) navigation.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: useLocalSearchParams is the Expo Router-native API and correctly updates when params change via any navigation mechanism including dangerouslySingular. navigateToSession() uses router.navigate which explicitly targets the correct session route instead of relying on browser history.

dev.qa_notes: Test with Playwright: (1) navigate directly to /session/<id> via address bar - correct session must load; (2) navigate to a session via sidebar, click a tool to open /session/:id/message/:msgId, verify back button returns to correct parent session; (3) switch sessions via sidebar - verify URL updates and correct session displays. Pre-existing TypeScript errors (AttachmentMetadata, sidebarCollapsed, applySessionUsage) are unrelated to these changes.

recommendations: Audit all other Expo Router screens for remaining useRoute() usage from @react-navigation/native and replace with useLocalSearchParams
Audit other router.back() calls on web screens and replace with explicit navigate() where the parent screen may have been reached via dangerouslySingular
